a_control.title: A. Control - depth 0, glob **/* (this one must render)
a_control.description: Directly in form.properties with the broadest glob. If this does not list files, the problem is not nesting or globs at all - it is the dataset or the process wiring.

b_depth0_xenium.title: B. Depth 0 + .xenium glob
b_depth0_xenium.description: Same placement as A, but the glob used by the real form. If A renders and B does not, the .xenium glob is the problem.

c_nested.title: C. One plain object level down

c_depth1_xenium.title: C. Depth 1, plain object, .xenium glob
c_depth1_xenium.description: Nested one object deep with no conditional. This is the only shape in the repo with a nested dataset picker (community/pgap).

d_deep.title: D. Two plain object levels down

d_depth2_xenium.title: D. Depth 2, plain objects, .xenium glob
d_depth2_xenium.description: Same depth as the real form but with no conditional. Compare against E: if D renders and E does not, the allOf/if-then conditional is the cause.

e_conditional.title: E. Depth 2 behind a conditional (reproduces the real form)

e_switch.title: E. Set this to Show to reveal the picker
e_switch.description: Mirrors the Data Type selector in the real form.

e_depth2_conditional_xenium.title: E. Depth 2 + allOf/if-then, .xenium glob
e_depth2_conditional_xenium.description: Exactly the shape used by the real form: a picker declared only inside an allOf/then branch, two object levels down.

f_conditional_depth0.title: F. Conditional, but the picker is the only nested thing

f_switch.title: F. Set this to Show to reveal the picker

f_conditional_any.title: F. Depth 2 + allOf/if-then, glob **/*
f_conditional_any.description: Conditional picker with the broadest glob. Separates 'conditionals break pickers' from 'conditionals break this particular glob'.
